boon.description: Add an additional {Df} to the blessing’s effect

reckless.requirements: 3 or more favour, must be able to sing or play a musical instrument. Special: Add {Dm} to the dice pool for each target. Add 1 recharge token to this card for every 3 favour spent. You may continue to spend favour to add tokens to this card as a manoeuvre while it is recharging. Effect: You sing a cheerful tune, a favourite of sailors. While this blessing is recharging, all allies within close range add {Df} to the dice pool of all Willpower checks
